text.aria-label: Title text 'Station: Aug 2024 to Dec 2025, 34,156 farm-hours'
Title text 'Figure 1: Mean absolute error of each weather product's wind, on four row sets'
text.tspan: Figure 1: Mean absolute error of each weather product's wind, on four
row sets

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each arm's own mean absolute error, sorted best first within its block. Compare arms only within a block: each block is scored on its own rows, so an error in one block is not comparable with an error in another. Overlapping intervals do not make two arms equal: the intervals are wide mainly because every arm's error swings together from month to month, a swing that Figure 2's paired contrasts cancel. The station rows rest on one nearby weather station per farm, and cover fewer months than the other blocks. Main: 16.4% of scored rows are in a calendar month, seen in two or more years, with no training row in their fold, and 0.0% are in a calendar month seen in one year only, which no fold design can cover. ICON-DREAM-EU: 25.1% of scored rows are in a calendar month, seen in two or more years, with no training row in their fold, and 0.0% are in a calendar month seen in one year only, which no fold design can cover; covering those months moves its two planned contrasts by +0.009 and -0.028 points at the primary setting, with no change of sign or of statistical significance; absolute errors under covering folds are expected to be slightly lower, by analogy with the past-solar study; not measured for this block. ECMWF: 0.0% of scored rows are in a calendar month, seen in two or more years, with no training row in their fold, and 9.4% are in a calendar month seen in one year only, which no fold design can cover. Station: 0.0% of scored rows are in a calendar month, seen in two or more years, with no training row in their fold, and 42.2% are in a calendar month seen in one year only, which no fold design can cover. Wind heights of each block's arms: Main: 100 m; ICON 80 m. ICON-DREAM-EU: 100 m; ICON 80 m; ICON-DREAM-EU 96 m. ECMWF: 100 m; ICON 80 m. Station: 10 m station and ERA5 arm; 100 m others. ICON-DREAM-EU: planned contrasts were written after the main block's five products were scored. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire. Lighter, hollow rows are ERA5, repeated in every block as a yardstick and scored on that block's own rows; in the station block they are ERA5's 10 m wind.'
